parity_guarantee: All features computed by calling extract_features(url) from this module. Training and live prediction use the SAME code path.

feature_descriptions.URLLength: Total length of normalized URL string
feature_descriptions.IsDomainIP: 1 if hostname is an IPv4/IPv6 address
feature_descriptions.TLDLegitimateProb: Estimated legitimacy probability of TLD (lookup table)
feature_descriptions.NoOfSubDomain: Number of subdomain levels beyond registered domain
feature_descriptions.ObfuscationRatio: Ratio of percent-encoded chars to URL length
feature_descriptions.NoOfLettersInURL: Count of alphabetic characters in full URL
feature_descriptions.LetterRatioInURL: Ratio of alphabetic characters to URL length
feature_descriptions.NoOfDegitsInURL: Count of digit characters in full URL
feature_descriptions.DegitRatioInURL: Ratio of digit characters to URL length
feature_descriptions.SpacialCharRatioInURL: Ratio of special chars (=?& + other) to URL length
feature_descriptions.URLCharProb: Fraction of URL chars in standard RFC URL character set
feature_descriptions.CharContinuationRate: Longest consecutive same-char run / URL length
feature_descriptions.Bank: 1 if banking keywords present in URL
feature_descriptions.Pay: 1 if payment keywords present in URL
feature_descriptions.Crypto: 1 if cryptocurrency keywords present in URL

excluded_features_reason.URLSimilarityIndex: Requires brand reference database (not portable to live inference)
excluded_features_reason.URL: Raw string used as source for all other features
excluded_features_reason.TLD: Raw TLD string (TLDLength + TLDLegitimateProb used instead)

training_note: Features recomputed from raw URL strings using src/feature_extraction.py. Dataset pre-computed columns NOT used. Training == Live parity guaranteed.
